summary:
Create professional PowerPoint presentations with PI (Presentation Intelligence). Turn topics, ideas, outlines, questions, or documents into structured, visually polished, and fully editable PPT decks. Ideal for business reports, proposals, training materials, courseware, product introductions, and project presentations. The final generated PPT file can be downloaded and reused.

使用 PI（Presentation Intelligence）快速生成专业 PPT。用户可以输入主题、问题、大纲、想法，或上传参考文档，技能会自动完成内容规划、页面结构设计、文案生成和版式排版，最终生成可下载、可编辑、可复用的 PP
